title: The vintage beauty of Soviet control rooms (2018)
summary: An article exploring the unique retro-futuristic aesthetic of Soviet-era control rooms, highlighting their distinctive industrial design that blends functionality with artistic expression through bold colors, intricate instrument panels, and communist iconography.
problem_solved: Documents and celebrates the unique visual aesthetics of Soviet industrial control rooms that combined utilitarian purpose with artistic expression.
why_valuable: Preserves and shares appreciation for a forgotten design era that represents a distinctive fusion of technology, politics, and art rarely seen in modern architecture.
